items.title: The locus where a map from a finite module to a finitely presented module is an isomorphism is open
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a map from a finite module to a finitely presented module the set of primes where the localised map is an isomorphism is open (statement lines 19625-19635). The proof writes down an explicit inverse around a point of the locus by pulling back the generators and the relations of a presentation, then clears the finitely many denominators to obtain a basic open on which the two maps are mutually inverse (proof lines 19637-19661). Finiteness of the presentation is exactly what makes the number of conditions finite. H2.
